verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a data export feature, open-format bulk export, or offboarding path. Community reports describe trouble leaving and suggest pulling customers out via the API, but that is a user-side workaround built on developer building blocks and earns no credit. The same reports say card data and transaction history likely cannot be migrated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: use the LS API to export customers and reimport them into Stripe
